parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((function(){ var f = $('Extract + Filter P1/P2').item.json; var kev = f.kev ? 'YES - actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV)' : 'No'; var fix = f.fixed ? f.fixed : 'no fixed version available'; var epss = f.epss != null ? (f.epss * 100).toFixed(2) + '%' : 'unknown'; var lines = [ '## Remediation ticket', '', '| Field | Value |', '|---|---|', '| CVE | ' + f.cve + ' |', '| Asset | ' + f.asset_name + ' (' + f.asset_criticality + ' importance) |', '| Package | ' + f.pkg + ' - installed ' + f.installed + ', fixed in ' + fix + ' |', '| Severity | ' + f.severity + ' (CVSS ' + f.cvss + ') |', '| EPSS exploitation probability | ' + epss + ' |', '| CISA KEV listed | ' + kev + ' |', '| Contextual priority | ' + f.priority_score + ' / 100 - ' + f.priority + ' |', '', '> ' + (f.title || ''), '', '### Priority formula', 'P = 0.25*CVSS + 0.30*EPSS + 0.25*KEV + 0.20*Asset importance', '', '### Acceptance criteria', '- [ ] Apply the fix (upgrade package or rebuild image)', '- [ ] Request verification scan', '- [ ] Ticket is closed ONLY if a new scan proves the finding is gone' ]; return { title: '[' + f.priority + '] Fix ' + f.cve + ' on ' + f.asset_name, body: lines.join('\n') }; })()) }}

meta.description: Receives enriched findings from the Laravel dashboard, filters P1/P2, dedupes against open Gitea tickets and creates remediation tickets.
